title: Chocolate banana cake
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Chocolate banana cake. Ingredient reference: Plain chocolate, Banana, Flour, Eggs, Butter, Sugar, Baking powder. Preparation reference: One batch makes 8 portions. Preparation: 20 minutes; cooking: 35 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 15 minutes. Heat the oven to 175 C conventional. Use 5 g of the butter to grease a 20 cm round cake tin. Melt the remaining butter and plain chocolate together in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring; remove from the heat. Mash the peeled bananas and beat with the eggs and sugar. Stir in the cooled chocolate mixture, then fold in the flour and baking powder. Pour into the tin and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer in the centre has no wet batter.
